SELECT count(*) total,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.shipper_id IS NULL) missing_shipper_id,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE d."shipperId" IS NULL) missing_orm_shipperId,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.shipper_id IS NOT NULL AND d."shipperId" IS NOT NULL AND d.shipper_id<>d."shipperId") both_present_conflict,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.shipper_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id IS NULL) shipper_id_orphan,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE d."shipperId" IS NOT NULL AND s2.id IS NULL) orm_shipperId_orphan
FROM orders.shipper_delivery d
LEFT JOIN orders.shipper s ON d.shipper_id=s.id
LEFT JOIN orders.shipper s2 ON d."shipperId"=s2.id
